# NanoC agent entry

- Everything is NanoC under `src/`; `build.c` is the only C source. Docs, editors, headers and the website are generated by `src/*.bt.nc` (`./builder docs`).
- Compiler modules: `src/**/*.nc`, at most 200 lines, doc comment per function. Edit NanoC; never hand-edit generated seed C or generated docs.
- Preserve unmarked C/C++. New code uses `@f name(args) int`, bare types and indentation: no arrows, block colons, braces or semicolons.
- Bootstrap: `cc -std=c11 -O2 build.c -o builder`; `./builder test`; `./builder bootstrap` byte-compares three generations. Refresh seed: `./builder snapshot`, then `./builder bootstrap`.
- Sanitizers: `CC=clang ./builder test --sanitize`.
- Language lookup: `build/nanoc --describe syntax|builtins|asm|NAME`. Repair loop: `nanoc input.nc --check --diagnostics json`.
- `--check` validates expansion only and disables BT writes/commands. `--max-passes 0 --max-steps 0` removes count limits.
- Builtin metadata lives in `src/meta/registry.nc`. Layout: `docs/architecture.md`. Keep upstream corpus/license/hash files intact.
